svg.title: Verified cross-system relationships
svg.desc: Every row is one implementation relationship recorded in the public system registry. Systems repeat when they participate in more than one relationship. 17 implementation relationships are backed by the evidence IDs on their registry records. The map does not infer family, ownership, or general-association lines. The registry is a checked snapshot. Local source or a public release can change after its recorded verification date.
